verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation is a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no user-definable rules engine that triggers actions on events. Webhooks only push events to an endpoint, where the developer must write the reaction logic; that is a building block, not the capability. Smart Disputes and offline auto-forwarding are fixed built-in behaviors, not user-defined rules, so they are adjacent features only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
